'Ore dake Level Up na Ken' Gets Sequel Movie
The Crunchyroll Showcase at Anime Expo 2026 announced a sequel movie titled Beyond the System for the Ore dake Level Up na Ken (Solo Leveling) anime series on Friday. It revealed a teaser visual (pictured) and a teaser trailer. Produced by A-1 Pictures, the anime series adapting Chugong and DUBU's action adventure manhwa aired in two seasons in Winter 2024 and Winter 2025. Multimedia Project 'Alien Stage' Receives Anime Adaptation
The Animate Presents: ALIEN STAGE Panel at Anime Expo 2026 revealed that an anime adaptation of Vivinos' and Qmeng's Alien Stage multimedia project is in production on Thursday. Produced by LICO, the 12-episode sci-fi music drama aired from September 2022 to June 2025 on Youtube. A spin-off series titled Zombie Stage began on June 26. The official website for the Kusuriya no Hitorigoto anime series revealed the production staff, additional cast, teaser visual (pictured), and a teaser trailer for the anime movie on Friday.
